input.instruction: Prepare only the requested notice/document operation. add_interested_party targets r1 with value {"recipient_record": "r#"} referencing the supplied name/email. send_proof targets r1 with value {"recipient_record": "r#"}. Adding an interested party and one-time proof delivery are separate actions.

messages.text: My landlord wants its office listed to receive proof-of-insurance notices. Please add the Wren Property Office contact attached here.
Please confirm the exact name and destination, and whether you intend to add an insured person.
I approve Wren Property Office at notices@wren-property.example as the interested party for notices. Do not add an insured person or send any other document right now.

interested_party_record.description: Supplied record containing the confirmed interested-party name and email.

notice_request_ready.description: Whether this interested-party notice request meets authority and recipient prerequisites.

named_insured_change_requested.description: Whether adding or changing a named insured is requested.

proof_delivery_requested.description: Whether a separate one-time proof document delivery is requested now.
